note: The overflow check compares plen + hdrlen against len, but plen is a long and hdrlen is an int; the addition can overflow when plen is near LONG_MAX, allowing a crafted length to pass the bounds check.
The attacker-controlled length is decoded and plen is returned; if the overflow check is bypassed, plen can exceed the actual buffer size.
The pointer is advanced by the unchecked plen value, moving p beyond the end of the input buffer.
Subsequent field decoding reads from the out-of-bounds pointer p, causing an out-of-bounds read during the decoding process.
